instruction: Star exactly 2 emails in the Drafts folder

rules.sql: select count(*) = 2 from messageAttributes where attributeID = 58 and value = 1 and messageID in (select id from messages where folderID = 7);

metadata.explanation: Task requires starring exactly 2 emails in Drafts folder (folderID=7, contains 7 emails). The evaluator checks if exactly 2 messages in folder 7 have star attribute. SQL returns 1 (true) if count equals 2. Verified from database: folder 7 is Drafts with 7 emails.
